readme.markdown:
# SimplyPrint Claude Code marketplace

Official Claude Code marketplace from [SimplyPrint](https://simplyprint.io). Hosts the SimplyPrint plugin for Claude Code so you can manage your 3D printer farm without leaving your terminal.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add simplyprint/simplyprint-claude-plugin
/plugin install simplyprint@simplyprint
```

## Plugins

| Plugin | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| [`simplyprint`](./plugins/simplyprint) | Connects Claude Code to your SimplyPrint account via the official SimplyPrint MCP server. Includes starter skills for common workflows. |

## Hosting it yourself

This whole repo is the marketplace. Anyone can add it with `/plugin marketplace add simplyprint/simplyprint-claude-plugin`. To run a fork, just point users at your repo instead.

See [`.claude-plugin/marketplace.json`](./.claude-plugin/marketplace.json) for the catalog and [Claude Code marketplace docs](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/plugin-marketplaces) for how this all works.

toolsPreview.name: list_printers
toolsPreview.description: List MULTIPLE printers with optional filters. For details on a single known printer, call get_printer instead — do not list-then-filter. For farm-wide counts ("how many printers are doing X"), call get_farm_overview instead — do not paginate this. Use status=["online"] to only see reachable printers, status=["printing"] for ones actively printing, status=["was_printing_when_offline"] for printers that dropped mid-print, status=["idle"] for available printers ready to accept a job, status=["awaiting_bed_clear"] for printers whose last print finished but the bed has not been cleared yet (NOT print_pending, which means a queued staggered start).

toolsPreview.name: get_printer
toolsPreview.description: Get details, status, temps, current job, filament, notifications for ONE specific printer by id. Use this (not list_printers) whenever the user asks about a single printer they've already identified — "status of printer X", "what's printer 5 doing", "temperature on Creality K2". Cheaper and less noisy than listing all printers.

toolsPreview.name: get_farm_overview
toolsPreview.description: One-shot summary of farm-wide printer state. Use this (NOT list_printers) when the user asks "how many printers are printing/idle/awaiting bed clear/etc." or "what is the state of the farm". Returns a total and {count, printers:[{id,name}]} for each bucket: online, offline, not_connected, operational (idle), printing, paused, awaiting_bed_clear (a print finished but the bed has not been cleared yet — printer is online + operational + still has a job; this is NOT print_pending), in_maintenance, print_pending (a queued staggered/scheduled start), requires_attention (has unresolved error notifications), ai_running, ai_detected_low, ai_detected_high. Counts overlap intentionally: a printer can be in "online" + "printing" + "ai_running" at once.

toolsPreview.name: pause_print
toolsPreview.description: Pause the current print on a printer

toolsPreview.name: resume_print

toolsPreview.name: cancel_print

toolsPreview.name: send_gcode
toolsPreview.description: Send G-code commands to a printer

toolsPreview.name: create_print_job
toolsPreview.description: Start a print job on one or more printers. File source is exactly one of: file_id (API file hash from upload), filesystem (user-file uid), queue_file (existing queue item id), reprint (previous print-job id), or next_queue_item=true (auto-pick the next matching queue item per printer, deduplicated across printers). Supports PRINT_JOB custom fields (shared and per-printer). Auto-starts when the account's autostartPrints setting is on (default).

toolsPreview.name: home_printer
toolsPreview.description: Home the printer axes (move to origin position)

toolsPreview.name: move_printer_axis
toolsPreview.description: Move a printer axis to a relative position

toolsPreview.name: set_printer_fans
toolsPreview.description: Control the printer cooling fans

toolsPreview.name: set_printer_motors
toolsPreview.description: Enable or disable the printer stepper motors

toolsPreview.name: set_printer_temperatures
toolsPreview.description: Set target temperatures (nozzle, bed and/or chamber) on one or more printers - works while idle and mid-print. Values above the printer model maximum are clamped; 0 turns a heater off.

toolsPreview.name: list_queue
toolsPreview.description: List print queue items with optional filters. Supports filtering by assigned printer(s), group, approval status, tags, queue-item custom-field values, and age. Example: older_than_days=7 for "items added more than 7 days ago", or custom_fields=[{id: "<uuid>", value: "Engineering"}] for a specific department field.

toolsPreview.name: get_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Get details of a specific queue item

toolsPreview.name: remove_from_queue
toolsPreview.description: Remove an item from the print queue

toolsPreview.name: add_to_queue
toolsPreview.description: Queue a file for printing. Pick exactly one file source: fileId (hex hash from the files.simplyprint.io Upload endpoint) or filesystem (UserFile.uid of an existing library file). Supports PRINT_QUEUE custom fields.

toolsPreview.name: update_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Update a queue item (amount, note, custom print time, material usage, printer assignments).

toolsPreview.name: reorder_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Move a single queue item to a new 1-based position.

toolsPreview.name: move_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Move one or more queue items to a different queue group.

toolsPreview.name: revive_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Bring a completed (done) queue item back to the active queue.

toolsPreview.name: empty_queue
toolsPreview.description: DESTRUCTIVE: Delete all items from the queue (optionally filtered by group or done-only). Confirm with the user before calling.

toolsPreview.name: inspect_printer_queue
toolsPreview.description: Show which queue items match/miss a specific printer and why. Useful for diagnosing why a queue item will not print.

toolsPreview.name: get_queue_item_cost
toolsPreview.description: Calculate the estimated cost of a queue item, optionally for a specific printer.

toolsPreview.name: get_next_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Find the best-matching queue item(s) for a set of printers using SimplyPrint's compatibility matcher.

toolsPreview.name: get_next_queue_items_for_printers
toolsPreview.description: Read-only preview: for each given printer, return the next queue item that would be started. Uses the same dedup matcher as create_print_job with next_queue_item=true, so the same queue item is never returned twice across printers in one call. Includes match failures per printer (issues) so you can explain why a printer has nothing to print. Does NOT start any job.

toolsPreview.name: list_queue_groups
toolsPreview.description: List all queue groups in the user's account.

toolsPreview.name: save_queue_group
toolsPreview.description: Create a new queue group or update an existing one.

toolsPreview.name: delete_queue_group
toolsPreview.description: Delete a queue group. Optionally move its items to another group via move_to.

toolsPreview.name: reorder_queue_group

toolsPreview.name: list_pending_queue_items

toolsPreview.name: approve_queue_item

toolsPreview.name: deny_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Deny a pending queue item, either removing it or requesting revisions. Include a comment explaining the decision.

toolsPreview.name: send_back_for_revision
toolsPreview.description: Revoke approval on an already-approved item and send it back to the submitter for revisions.

toolsPreview.name: resubmit_queue_item
toolsPreview.description: Resubmit a denied or revision-requested queue item back to pending approval. File-replacement is not supported via MCP.

toolsPreview.name: list_queue_comments
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve all approval comments on a queue item or user file.

toolsPreview.name: add_queue_comment
toolsPreview.description: Add a comment (general or feedback) to a queue item or user file. File attachments are not supported via MCP.

toolsPreview.name: update_queue_comment
toolsPreview.description: Edit an approval comment you authored.

toolsPreview.name: delete_queue_comment
toolsPreview.description: Delete an approval comment you authored (or any comment if you have the permission).

toolsPreview.name: list_custom_fields
toolsPreview.description: List custom field definitions with pagination and search.

toolsPreview.name: list_custom_fields_for
toolsPreview.description: List custom field definitions for a specific entity category and optional sub-category (e.g. PRINT + PRINT_QUEUE for queue-item custom fields).

toolsPreview.name: set_custom_field_values
toolsPreview.description: Set custom field values on one or more entities (queue items, files, printers, etc.). Use this to set a "deadline" or similar field across many queue items at once.

toolsPreview.name: list_files
toolsPreview.description: List files and folders in the user's SimplyPrint storage. With pid set, only returns files compatible with that printer (full compatibility check). With global_search=true (default), searches recursively across all folders.

toolsPreview.description: Get a folder's details including permissions.

toolsPreview.description: Estimate the print cost of a file, optionally for a specific printer.

toolsPreview.name: match_file_to_printers
toolsPreview.description: Find which printer models in the account are compatible with a given file.

toolsPreview.name: set_file_printers
toolsPreview.description: Set the printers/models/groups a file is assigned to.

toolsPreview.name: update_file
toolsPreview.description: Update file metadata such as name and GCODE analysis.

toolsPreview.name: create_folder
toolsPreview.description: Create a new folder (or edit an existing one with optional org-level permissions).

toolsPreview.name: delete_folder
toolsPreview.description: Delete one or more folders.

toolsPreview.name: move_file
toolsPreview.description: Move one or more files to a folder.

toolsPreview.name: move_folder
toolsPreview.description: Move a folder to another location.

toolsPreview.name: delete_file
toolsPreview.description: Delete one or more files.

toolsPreview.name: get_slicer_settings_for_file
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve slicer settings stored for a file.

toolsPreview.name: list_filaments
toolsPreview.description: List filament spools with optional filters and sorting. Accounts often have hundreds of spools, so ALWAYS pair sort_by with a limit. Use sort_by=last_used + limit=10 for "most used / most popular spool" questions. Use sort_by=created + limit=N for recently added. Use sort_by=left for emptiest/fullest. Filters (material_type/brand/color) are case-insensitive substring matches. If the user names a specific spool by id or 4-character short id (e.g. "T2SO"), call get_filament instead — do NOT list and grep. Amount-remaining fields: report weight from leftGrams/totalGrams (grams) and percentLeft (%), NOT the raw total/left which are internal filament LENGTH in mm. density (g/cm³) is the value used for the gram conversion; densityIsEstimated=true means the spool has no material profile so a default density was assumed.

toolsPreview.name: get_filament
toolsPreview.description: Get details of one specific filament spool. Use this (NOT list_filaments+grep) when the user names a spool by id or short id. Accepts spool_id (the integer DB id) or spool_short_id (the 4-character code shown on QR labels and the spool view page, e.g. "T2SO", "M0WT").

toolsPreview.name: adjust_filament_weight
toolsPreview.description: Adjust the remaining weight of a filament spool (e.g. after manual weighing).

toolsPreview.name: assign_filament
toolsPreview.description: Assign a filament spool to a printer (or a specific extruder slot).

toolsPreview.name: unassign_filament
toolsPreview.description: Remove a filament spool from its printer assignment.

toolsPreview.name: get_filament_history
toolsPreview.description: Retrieve the usage history of a filament spool.

toolsPreview.name: mark_filament_dried
toolsPreview.description: Mark a filament spool as freshly dried (resets humidity tracking).

toolsPreview.name: list_filament_colors
toolsPreview.description: List available filament colors (for UI pickers or picking similar spools).

toolsPreview.name: list_brand_filaments
toolsPreview.description: List filament products from a specific brand.

toolsPreview.name: list_print_jobs
toolsPreview.description: List past print jobs with pagination, filters, and sort. Compact mode (default) drops gcodeAnalysis, filament breakdowns, and panel-only flags.

toolsPreview.name: get_print_job
toolsPreview.description: Get detailed info for a specific print job.

toolsPreview.name: archive_print_job
toolsPreview.description: Archive a print job (hide from default history listings).

toolsPreview.name: unarchive_print_job
toolsPreview.description: Restore an archived print job.

toolsPreview.name: get_account_statistics
toolsPreview.description: Account-level print statistics (success rate, filament used, print time, cost) with optional date range and user/printer filters.

toolsPreview.name: get_maintenance_dashboard
toolsPreview.description: Overview of maintenance jobs, problems, inventory, and printer maintenance status.

toolsPreview.name: get_referral_stats
toolsPreview.description: Referral program statistics: conversions, earnings, pending payout.

toolsPreview.name: get_webhook_sample
toolsPreview.description: Get one or more realistic sample webhook payloads for a specific event type, matching the envelope a live webhook delivery would produce. Used by integration platforms (Activepieces, n8n, Zapier) to show the payload shape before any real event fires. Falls back to synthetic data when no applicable entity exists in the account.
